title:
WHAT IF DINOSAURS
CAME BACK
FOR 10 YEARS?
narration: What if tomorrow morning the dinosaurs came back to Earth… and stayed for ten years?

label: YEAR 1
title: THE CHAOS
narration: Year one. Total chaos. A T-Rex weighs as much as a truck and runs at twenty miles per hour. Cities become traps: armies in the streets, millions of people on the run.

label: YEAR 2
title: THE FAMINE
narration: Year two. The real problem is the herbivores. One Brachiosaurus eats nine hundred pounds of plants a day. Entire harvests vanish overnight, and the price of bread triples.

label: YEAR 3
title: CLOSED SKIES
narration: Year three. The pterosaurs take over the sky. A thirty-foot wingspan: a few impacts are enough, and global air traffic grinds to a halt.

label: YEAR 5
title: WE ADAPT
narration: Year five. Humanity adapts. Hundred-foot walls around the cities, surveillance drones… and a billion-dollar business: dino-tourism.

label: YEAR 7
title: NATURE DECIDES
narration: Year seven. But nature takes its course. Today's air has less oxygen, the plants are different, and modern viruses are unknown to them. The giants begin to die.

label: YEAR 10
title: THE END
narration: Year ten. They disappear, one after another. What's left: wounded cities, fields turned into forests… and a planet reminding us who's really in charge.

title: WOULD YOU SURVIVE?
narration: Would you have survived? Tell me in the comments, and follow for the next: what if…
